construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H25-006 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Approved, issue date 2025-12-17: "Site Development Permit to allow the demolition of an existing fire-damaged 4-plex apartment building for the construction of a new three-story 16-unit multifamily building with two density bonus units and removal of four ordinance-size trees on an approx" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City building permit 2026-131400-MF (New Construction, Apartment), issued 2026-08-07: 16 dwelling units, 11,447 sq ft, permit valuation $1,810,686, contractor AXL Builders (Alex Ghanavati), applicant Leopold Design.

Preliminary review PRE24-352 (filed 2024-12-01, status Complete) described a 2-story 12-unit building replacing the fire-damaged 4-plex. Environmental review ER25-035 (exemption) issued 2025-12-17. AD26-056, Development Agreement for Housing Compliance, filed 2026-02-05, status Under Review.
City permit H25-006 shows two density bonus units; the state report shows 4 deed-restricted lower-income units at application.
